# Slack

How the example agent behaves in the example chat workspace.

### Write in English only in the shared workspace.
- Why: The example team works in one shared language.
- Enforced: The sender refuses text outside the allowed languages.
- Added: 2026-01-01

### Never post a bare URL; label every link (repo, number, title).
- Why: Bare links are hard to read on a small screen.
- Enforced: Convention.
- Added: 2026-01-01
- Lesson: An unlabeled link in a status update was skipped by every reader.

### Greet a new member once, in the channel they joined.
- Why: A single greeting is welcoming; several are noise.
- Enforced: Convention.
- Added: 2026-01-02
